theorem fiberwise_dist_lt_imp_dist_lt_unique_decoding_radius (i : Fin ℓ) (steps : ℕ)
    [NeZero steps] (h_i_add_steps : i.val + steps ≤ ℓ)
    (f : OracleFunction 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩)
  (h_fw_dist_lt : fiberwiseClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    (i := i) (steps := steps) (h_i_add_steps := h_i_add_steps) (f := f)) :
  hammingClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩ f := by
  let C := BBF_Code 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩
  let d := fiberwiseDistance 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f
  let S := (fun g : C => (fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g).ncard) '' Set.univ
  obtain ⟨g, _, hg⟩ := Nat.sInf_mem (Set.image_nonempty.mpr Set.univ_nonempty : S.Nonempty)
  let Y := fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g
  let D := Finset.univ.filter (fun x => f x ≠ g x)
  let q := iteratedQuotientMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i steps h_i_add_steps
  let k := pointToIterateQuotientIndex (𝔽q := 𝔽q) (β := β)
    (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := steps) (h_i_add_steps := h_i_add_steps)
  have hr x : qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := steps)
      (h_i_add_steps := by omega) (q x) (k x) = x :=
    (is_fiber_iff_generates_quotient_point 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps x (q x)).mp rfl
  have hd : hammingDist f g ≤ Y.ncard * 2 ^ steps := by
    have h := Finset.card_le_card_of_injOn (fun x => (q x, k x))
      (s := D) (t := Y.toFinset ×ˢ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (2 ^ steps))))
      (by
        intro x hx
        simp only [Finset.mem_product, Set.mem_toFinset, Finset.mem_univ, and_true]
        exact ⟨x, rfl, (Finset.mem_filter.mp hx).2⟩)
      (by
        intro x hx z hz h
        obtain ⟨hq, hk⟩ := Prod.mk.inj h
        rw [←hr x, ←hr z, hq, hk])
    simpa only [D, hammingDist, Finset.card_product, Finset.card_univ,
      Fintype.card_fin, Set.toFinset_card, ← Set.ncard_eq_toFinset_card'] using h
  have hb : 2 * d ≤ 2 ^ (ℓ + 𝓡 - (i.val + steps)) - 2 ^ (ℓ - (i.val + steps)) :=
    Nat.le_of_lt_succ (WithTop.coe_lt_coe.1 h_fw_dist_lt)
  have ha : (2 ^ (ℓ + 𝓡 - (i.val + steps)) - 2 ^ (ℓ - (i.val + steps))) * 2 ^ steps =
      2 ^ (ℓ + 𝓡 - i.val) - 2 ^ (ℓ - i.val) := by
    rw [Nat.sub_mul, ←Nat.pow_add, ←Nat.pow_add,
      show ℓ + 𝓡 - (i.val + steps) + steps = ℓ + 𝓡 - i.val by omega,
      show ℓ - (i.val + steps) + steps = ℓ - i.val by omega]
  have hn : 2 * hammingDist f g < BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 ⟨i, by omega⟩ := by
    apply Nat.lt_succ_of_le
    calc
      2 * hammingDist f g ≤ 2 * (Y.ncard * 2 ^ steps) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 hd
      _ = (2 * d) * 2 ^ steps := by rw [←hg, mul_assoc]; rfl
      _ ≤ (2 ^ (ℓ + 𝓡 - (i.val + steps)) - 2 ^ (ℓ - (i.val + steps))) * 2 ^ steps :=
        Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hb
      _ = _ := ha
  unfold hammingClose
  apply (mul_le_mul_left' (Code.distFromCode_le_dist_to_mem f g g.property) 2).trans_lt
  exact_mod_cast hn

theorem fiberwise_dist_lt_imp_dist_lt_unique_decoding_radius (i : Fin ℓ) (steps : ℕ)
    [NeZero steps] (h_i_add_steps : i.val + steps ≤ ℓ)
    (f : OracleFunction 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩)
  (h_fw_dist_lt : fiberwiseClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    (i := i) (steps := steps) (h_i_add_steps := h_i_add_steps) (f := f)) :
  hammingClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩ f := by
  let C := BBF_Code 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩
  let d := fiberwiseDistance 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f
  let S := (fun g : C => (fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g).ncard) '' Set.univ
  obtain ⟨g, _, hg⟩ := Nat.sInf_mem (Set.image_nonempty.mpr Set.univ_nonempty : S.Nonempty)
  let Y := fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g
  let D := Finset.univ.filter (fun x => f x ≠ g.val x)
  let q := iteratedQuotientMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i steps h_i_add_steps
  let k := pointToIterateQuotientIndex (𝔽q := 𝔽q) (β := β)
    (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := steps) (h_i_add_steps := h_i_add_steps)
  have hr x : qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := steps)
      (h_i_add_steps := by omega) (q x) (k x) = x :=
    (is_fiber_iff_generates_quotient_point 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps x (q x)).mp rfl
  have hd : hammingDist f g ≤ Y.ncard * 2 ^ steps := by
    have h := Finset.card_le_card_of_injOn (fun x => (q x, k x))
      (s := D) (t := Y.toFinset ×ˢ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (2 ^ steps))))
      (by
        intro x hx
        simp only [Finset.mem_product, Set.mem_toFinset, Finset.mem_univ, and_true]
        exact ⟨x, rfl, (Finset.mem_filter.mp hx).2⟩)
      (by
        intro x hx z hz h
        obtain ⟨hq, hk⟩ := Prod.mk.inj h
        rw [←hr x, ←hr z, hq, hk])
    simpa only [D, hammingDist, Finset.card_product, Finset.card_univ,
      Fintype.card_fin, ← Set.ncard_eq_toFinset_card'] using h
  have hb : 2 * d ≤ 2 ^ (ℓ + 𝓡 - (i.val + steps)) - 2 ^ (ℓ - (i.val + steps)) :=
    Nat.le_of_lt_succ (WithTop.coe_lt_coe.1 h_fw_dist_lt)
  have ha : (2 ^ (ℓ + 𝓡 - (i.val + steps)) - 2 ^ (ℓ - (i.val + steps))) * 2 ^ steps =
      2 ^ (ℓ + 𝓡 - i.val) - 2 ^ (ℓ - i.val) := by
    rw [Nat.sub_mul, ←Nat.pow_add, ←Nat.pow_add,
      show ℓ + 𝓡 - (i.val + steps) + steps = ℓ + 𝓡 - i.val by omega,
      show ℓ - (i.val + steps) + steps = ℓ - i.val by omega]
  have hn : 2 * hammingDist f g < BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 ⟨i, by omega⟩ := by
    apply Nat.lt_succ_of_le
    calc
      2 * hammingDist f g ≤ 2 * (Y.ncard * 2 ^ steps) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 hd
      _ = (2 * d) * 2 ^ steps := by rw [←hg, mul_assoc]; rfl
      _ ≤ (2 ^ (ℓ + 𝓡 - (i.val + steps)) - 2 ^ (ℓ - (i.val + steps))) * 2 ^ steps :=
        Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hb
      _ = _ := ha
  unfold hammingClose
  apply (mul_le_mul_left' (Code.distFromCode_le_dist_to_mem f g g.property) 2).trans_lt
  exact_mod_cast hn

theorem fiberwise_dist_lt_imp_dist_lt_unique_decoding_radius (i : Fin ℓ) (steps : ℕ)
    [NeZero steps] (h_i_add_steps : i.val + steps ≤ ℓ)
    (f : OracleFunction 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩)
  (h_fw_dist_lt : fiberwiseClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    (i := i) (steps := steps) (h_i_add_steps := h_i_add_steps) (f := f)) :
  hammingClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩ f := by
  have hp (a : ℕ) (h : i.val + steps ≤ a) :
      2 ^ (a - (i.val + steps)) * 2 ^ steps = 2 ^ (a - i.val) := by
    rw [←Nat.pow_add,
      Nat.sub_add_eq_sub_sub_rev (h1 := Nat.le_add_left steps i.val) (h2 := h),
      Nat.add_sub_cancel]
  let C := BBF_Code 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, fin_ℓ_lt_ℓ_add_one i⟩
  let S := (fun g : C => (fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g.val).ncard) '' Set.univ
  obtain ⟨g, _, hg⟩ := Nat.sInf_mem (Set.image_nonempty.mpr Set.univ_nonempty : S.Nonempty)
  let Y := fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g.val
  change Y.ncard = fiberwiseDistance 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f at hg
  let D : Set _ := {x | f x ≠ g.val x}
  let q := iteratedQuotientMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i steps h_i_add_steps
  let k := pointToIterateQuotientIndex 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i, fin_ℓ_lt_ℓ_add_one i⟩ steps h_i_add_steps
  have hr x :=
    (is_fiber_iff_generates_quotient_point 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps x (q x)).mp rfl
  have hd := Set.ncard_le_ncard_of_injOn (fun x => (q x, k x))
    (s := D) (t := Y ×ˢ (Set.univ : Set (Fin (2 ^ steps))))
    (fun x hx => ⟨⟨x, rfl, hx⟩, Set.mem_univ _⟩)
    (by
      intro x hx z hz h
      obtain ⟨hq, hk⟩ := Prod.mk.inj h
      dsimp only [k] at hk
      rw [←hr x, ←hr z, hq, hk])
  rw [Set.ncard_prod, Set.ncard_univ, Nat.card_fin] at hd
  rw [Set.ncard_eq_toFinset_card', Set.toFinset_setOf] at hd
  have hb := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (2 ^ steps)
    (Nat.le_of_lt_succ (WithTop.coe_lt_coe.1 h_fw_dist_lt))
  rw [←hg, mul_assoc, Nat.sub_mul,
    hp (ℓ + 𝓡) (h_i_add_steps.trans (Nat.le_add_right ℓ 𝓡)), hp ℓ h_i_add_steps] at hb
  have hn := Nat.lt_succ_of_le ((Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 hd).trans hb)
  unfold hammingClose
  apply (mul_le_mul_left' (Code.distFromCode_le_dist_to_mem f g.val g.property) 2).trans_lt
  exact_mod_cast hn

theorem fiberwise_dist_lt_imp_dist_lt_unique_decoding_radius (i : Fin ℓ) (steps : ℕ)
    [NeZero steps] (h_i_add_steps : i.val + steps ≤ ℓ)
    (f : OracleFunction 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩)
  (h_fw_dist_lt : fiberwiseClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    (i := i) (steps := steps) (h_i_add_steps := h_i_add_steps) (f := f)) :
  hammingClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩ f := by
  let C := BBF_Code 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, fin_ℓ_lt_ℓ_add_one i⟩
  let Y (g : C) := fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g.val
  let S := (fun g => (Y g).ncard) '' Set.univ
  obtain ⟨g, _, hg⟩ := Nat.sInf_mem (Set.image_nonempty.mpr Set.univ_nonempty : S.Nonempty)
  change (Y g).ncard = fiberwiseDistance 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f at hg
  let D : Set _ := {x | f x ≠ g.val x}
  let q := iteratedQuotientMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i steps h_i_add_steps
  let k := pointToIterateQuotientIndex 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i, fin_ℓ_lt_ℓ_add_one i⟩ steps h_i_add_steps
  have hr x :=
    (is_fiber_iff_generates_quotient_point 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps x (q x)).mp rfl
  have hd := Set.ncard_le_ncard_of_injOn (fun x => (q x, k x))
    (s := D) (t := Y g ×ˢ (Set.univ : Set (Fin (2 ^ steps))))
    (fun x hx => ⟨⟨x, rfl, hx⟩, Set.mem_univ _⟩)
    (Function.LeftInverse.injective (f := fun x => (q x, k x))
      (g := fun p => _ p.1 p.2) hr).injOn
  rw [Set.ncard_prod, Set.ncard_univ, Nat.card_fin] at hd
  rw [Set.ncard_eq_toFinset_card', Set.toFinset_setOf] at hd
  have hb := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (2 ^ steps)
    (Nat.le_of_lt_succ (WithTop.coe_lt_coe.1 h_fw_dist_lt))
  rw [←hg, mul_assoc, Nat.sub_mul,
    ←Nat.sub_sub,
    pow_sub_mul_pow 2 (Nat.le_sub_of_add_le' (h_i_add_steps.trans (Nat.le_add_right ℓ 𝓡))),
    ←Nat.sub_sub, pow_sub_mul_pow 2 (Nat.le_sub_of_add_le' h_i_add_steps)] at hb
  have hn := Nat.lt_succ_of_le ((Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 hd).trans hb)
  exact (mul_le_mul_left' (Code.distFromCode_le_dist_to_mem f g.val g.property) 2).trans_lt
    (ENat.coe_lt_coe.2 hn)

theorem fiberwise_dist_lt_imp_dist_lt_unique_decoding_radius (i : Fin ℓ) (steps : ℕ)
    [NeZero steps] (h_i_add_steps : i.val + steps ≤ ℓ)
    (f : OracleFunction 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩)
  (h_fw_dist_lt : fiberwiseClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    (i := i) (steps := steps) (h_i_add_steps := h_i_add_steps) (f := f)) :
  hammingClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩ f := by
  let C := BBF_Code 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, fin_ℓ_lt_ℓ_add_one i⟩
  let Y (g : C) := fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g.val
  let S := (fun g => (Y g).ncard) '' Set.univ
  obtain ⟨g, _, hg⟩ := Nat.sInf_mem (Set.image_nonempty.mpr Set.univ_nonempty : S.Nonempty)
  change (Y g).ncard = fiberwiseDistance 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f at hg
  let D : Set _ := {x | f x ≠ g.val x}
  let q := iteratedQuotientMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i steps h_i_add_steps
  let k := pointToIterateQuotientIndex 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i, fin_ℓ_lt_ℓ_add_one i⟩ steps h_i_add_steps
  have hr x :=
    (is_fiber_iff_generates_quotient_point 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps x (q x)).mp rfl
  have hd := Set.ncard_le_ncard_of_injOn (fun x => (q x, k x))
    (s := D) (t := Y g ×ˢ (Set.univ : Set (Fin (2 ^ steps))))
    (fun x hx => ⟨⟨x, rfl, hx⟩, Set.mem_univ _⟩)
    (by
      intro x hx z hz h
      obtain ⟨hq, hk⟩ := Prod.mk.inj h
      exact (hr x).symm.trans ((congrArg₂ _ hq hk).trans (hr z)))
  rw [Set.ncard_prod, Set.ncard_univ, Nat.card_fin,
    Set.ncard_eq_toFinset_card', Set.toFinset_setOf] at hd
  have hb := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (2 ^ steps)
    (Nat.le_of_lt_succ (WithTop.coe_lt_coe.1 h_fw_dist_lt))
  rw [←hg, mul_assoc, Nat.sub_mul,
    ←Nat.sub_sub,
    pow_sub_mul_pow 2 (Nat.le_sub_of_add_le' (h_i_add_steps.trans (Nat.le_add_right ℓ 𝓡))),
    ←Nat.sub_sub, pow_sub_mul_pow 2 (Nat.le_sub_of_add_le' h_i_add_steps)] at hb
  have hn := Nat.lt_succ_of_le ((Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 hd).trans hb)
  exact (mul_le_mul_left' (Code.distFromCode_le_dist_to_mem f g.val g.property) 2).trans_lt
    (ENat.coe_lt_coe.2 hn)

theorem fiberwise_dist_lt_imp_dist_lt_unique_decoding_radius (i : Fin ℓ) (steps : ℕ)
    [NeZero steps] (h_i_add_steps : i.val + steps ≤ ℓ)
    (f : OracleFunction 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩)
  (h_fw_dist_lt : fiberwiseClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    (i := i) (steps := steps) (h_i_add_steps := h_i_add_steps) (f := f)) :
  hammingClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩ f := by
  let C := BBF_Code 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, fin_ℓ_lt_ℓ_add_one i⟩
  let Y (g : C) := fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g.val
  let S := (fun g => (Y g).ncard) '' Set.univ
  obtain ⟨g, _, hg⟩ := Nat.sInf_mem (Set.image_nonempty.mpr Set.univ_nonempty : S.Nonempty)
  change (Y g).ncard = fiberwiseDistance 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f at hg
  let D : Set _ := {x | f x ≠ g.val x}
  let q := iteratedQuotientMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i steps h_i_add_steps
  let k := pointToIterateQuotientIndex 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i, fin_ℓ_lt_ℓ_add_one i⟩ steps h_i_add_steps
  have hr x :=
    (is_fiber_iff_generates_quotient_point 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps x (q x)).mp rfl
  have hd := Set.ncard_le_ncard_of_injOn (fun x => (q x, k x))
    (s := D) (t := Y g ×ˢ (Set.univ : Set (Fin (2 ^ steps))))
    (fun x hx => ⟨⟨x, rfl, hx⟩, Set.mem_univ _⟩)
    (by
      intro x hx z hz h
      obtain ⟨hq, hk⟩ := Prod.mk.inj h
      exact (hr x).symm.trans ((congrArg₂ _ hq hk).trans (hr z)))
  rw [Set.ncard_prod, Set.ncard_univ, Nat.card_fin,
    D, ←Finset.coe_filter_univ, Set.ncard_coe_finset] at hd
  have hb := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (2 ^ steps)
    (Nat.le_of_lt_succ (WithTop.coe_lt_coe.1 h_fw_dist_lt))
  rw [←hg, mul_assoc, Nat.sub_mul,
    ←Nat.sub_sub,
    pow_sub_mul_pow 2 (Nat.le_sub_of_add_le' (h_i_add_steps.trans (Nat.le_add_right ℓ 𝓡))),
    ←Nat.sub_sub, pow_sub_mul_pow 2 (Nat.le_sub_of_add_le' h_i_add_steps)] at hb
  have hn := Nat.lt_succ_of_le ((Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 hd).trans hb)
  exact (mul_le_mul_left' (Code.distFromCode_le_dist_to_mem f g.val g.property) 2).trans_lt
    (ENat.coe_lt_coe.2 hn)

theorem fiberwise_dist_lt_imp_dist_lt_unique_decoding_radius (i : Fin ℓ) (steps : ℕ)
    [NeZero steps] (h_i_add_steps : i.val + steps ≤ ℓ)
    (f : OracleFunction 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩)
  (h_fw_dist_lt : fiberwiseClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    (i := i) (steps := steps) (h_i_add_steps := h_i_add_steps) (f := f)) :
  hammingClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩ f := by
  let C := BBF_Code 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, fin_ℓ_lt_ℓ_add_one i⟩
  let Y (g : C) := fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g.val
  let S := (fun g => (Y g).ncard) '' Set.univ
  obtain ⟨g, _, hg⟩ := Nat.sInf_mem (Set.image_nonempty.mpr Set.univ_nonempty : S.Nonempty)
  let q := iteratedQuotientMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i steps h_i_add_steps
  let k := pointToIterateQuotientIndex 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i, fin_ℓ_lt_ℓ_add_one i⟩ steps h_i_add_steps
  have hr x :=
    (is_fiber_iff_generates_quotient_point 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps x (q x)).mp rfl
  have hd := Set.ncard_le_ncard_of_injOn (fun x => (q x, k x))
    (s := {x | f x ≠ g.val x}) (t := Y g ×ˢ (Set.univ : Set (Fin (2 ^ steps))))
    (fun x hx => ⟨⟨x, rfl, hx⟩, Set.mem_univ _⟩)
    (by
      intro x hx z hz h
      obtain ⟨hq, hk⟩ := Prod.mk.inj h
      exact (hr x).symm.trans ((congrArg₂ _ hq hk).trans (hr z)))
  rw [Set.ncard_prod, Set.ncard_univ, Nat.card_fin,
    ←Finset.coe_filter_univ, Set.ncard_coe_finset] at hd
  have hb := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (2 ^ steps)
    (Nat.le_of_lt_succ (WithTop.coe_lt_coe.1 h_fw_dist_lt))
  rw [fiberwiseDistance, ←hg, mul_assoc, Nat.sub_mul,
    ←Nat.sub_sub,
    pow_sub_mul_pow 2 (Nat.le_sub_of_add_le' (h_i_add_steps.trans (Nat.le_add_right ℓ 𝓡))),
    ←Nat.sub_sub, pow_sub_mul_pow 2 (Nat.le_sub_of_add_le' h_i_add_steps)] at hb
  have hn := Nat.lt_succ_of_le ((Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 hd).trans hb)
  exact (mul_le_mul_left' (Code.distFromCode_le_dist_to_mem f g.val g.property) 2).trans_lt
    (ENat.coe_lt_coe.2 hn)

theorem fiberwise_dist_lt_imp_dist_lt_unique_decoding_radius (i : Fin ℓ) (steps : ℕ)
    [NeZero steps] (h_i_add_steps : i.val + steps ≤ ℓ)
    (f : OracleFunction 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩)
  (h_fw_dist_lt : fiberwiseClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    (i := i) (steps := steps) (h_i_add_steps := h_i_add_steps) (f := f)) :
  hammingClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩ f := by
  let C := BBF_Code 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, fin_ℓ_lt_ℓ_add_one i⟩
  let Y (g : C) := fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g.val
  let S := (fun g => (Y g).ncard) '' Set.univ
  obtain ⟨g, _, hg⟩ := Nat.sInf_mem (Set.image_nonempty.mpr Set.univ_nonempty : S.Nonempty)
  change (Y g).ncard = fiberwiseDistance 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f at hg
  let q := iteratedQuotientMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i steps h_i_add_steps
  let k := pointToIterateQuotientIndex 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i, fin_ℓ_lt_ℓ_add_one i⟩ steps h_i_add_steps
  have hr x :=
    (is_fiber_iff_generates_quotient_point 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps x (q x)).mp rfl
  have hd := Set.ncard_le_ncard_of_injOn (fun x => (q x, k x))
    (s := {x | f x ≠ g.val x}) (t := Y g ×ˢ (Set.univ : Set (Fin (2 ^ steps))))
    (fun x hx => ⟨⟨x, rfl, hx⟩, Set.mem_univ _⟩)
    (by
      intro x hx z hz h
      obtain ⟨hq, hk⟩ := Prod.mk.inj h
      exact (hr x).symm.trans ((congrArg₂ _ hq hk).trans (hr z)))
  rw [Set.ncard_prod, Set.ncard_univ, Nat.card_fin,
    ←Finset.coe_filter_univ, Set.ncard_coe_finset] at hd
  have hb := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (2 ^ steps)
    (Nat.le_of_lt_succ (WithTop.coe_lt_coe.1 h_fw_dist_lt))
  rw [←hg, mul_assoc, Nat.sub_mul,
    ←Nat.sub_sub,
    pow_sub_mul_pow 2 (Nat.le_sub_of_add_le' (h_i_add_steps.trans (Nat.le_add_right ℓ 𝓡))),
    ←Nat.sub_sub, pow_sub_mul_pow 2 (Nat.le_sub_of_add_le' h_i_add_steps)] at hb
  have hn := Nat.lt_succ_of_le ((Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 hd).trans hb)
  refine lt_of_le_of_lt ?_ (ENat.coe_lt_coe.2 hn)
  rw [Nat.cast_mul]
  apply mul_le_mul_left'
  exact sInf_le ⟨g.val, g.property, le_rfl⟩

theorem fiberwise_dist_lt_imp_dist_lt_unique_decoding_radius (i : Fin ℓ) (steps : ℕ)
    [NeZero steps] (h_i_add_steps : i.val + steps ≤ ℓ)
    (f : OracleFunction 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩)
  (h_fw_dist_lt : fiberwiseClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    (i := i) (steps := steps) (h_i_add_steps := h_i_add_steps) (f := f)) :
  hammingClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩ f := by
  let C := BBF_Code 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, fin_ℓ_lt_ℓ_add_one i⟩
  let Y (g : C) := fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g.val
  let S := (fun g => (Y g).ncard) '' Set.univ
  obtain ⟨g, _, hg⟩ := Nat.sInf_mem (Set.image_nonempty.mpr Set.univ_nonempty : S.Nonempty)
  change (Y g).ncard = fiberwiseDistance 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f at hg
  let q := iteratedQuotientMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i steps h_i_add_steps
  let k := pointToIterateQuotientIndex 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i, fin_ℓ_lt_ℓ_add_one i⟩ steps h_i_add_steps
  have hr x :=
    (is_fiber_iff_generates_quotient_point 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps x (q x)).mp rfl
  have hd := Set.ncard_le_ncard_of_injOn (fun x => (q x, k x))
    (s := {x | f x ≠ g.val x}) (t := Y g ×ˢ (Set.univ : Set (Fin (2 ^ steps))))
    (fun x hx => ⟨⟨x, rfl, hx⟩, Set.mem_univ _⟩)
    (by
      intro x hx z hz h
      obtain ⟨hq, hk⟩ := Prod.mk.inj h
      exact (hr x).symm.trans ((congrArg₂ _ hq hk).trans (hr z)))
  simp only [Set.ncard_prod, Set.ncard_univ, Nat.card_fin,
    ←Finset.coe_filter_univ, Set.ncard_coe_finset] at hd
  have hb := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (2 ^ steps)
    (Nat.le_of_lt_succ (WithTop.coe_lt_coe.1 h_fw_dist_lt))
  simp only [←hg, mul_assoc, Nat.sub_mul,
    ←Nat.sub_sub,
    pow_sub_mul_pow 2 (Nat.le_sub_of_add_le' (h_i_add_steps.trans (Nat.le_add_right ℓ 𝓡))),
    pow_sub_mul_pow 2 (Nat.le_sub_of_add_le' h_i_add_steps)] at hb
  have hn := Nat.lt_succ_of_le ((Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 hd).trans hb)
  exact (mul_le_mul_left' (Code.distFromCode_le_dist_to_mem f g.val g.property) 2).trans_lt
    (ENat.coe_lt_coe.2 hn)
